question: Who were our top 10 card spenders over the last three months?

artifacts.content: SELECT e.full_name, c.currency_code, SUM(c.amount) AS total_spend FROM card_transactions AS c JOIN employees AS e ON c.employee_id = e.employee_id WHERE c.transaction_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH) GROUP BY e.full_name, c.currency_code ORDER BY total_spend DESC LIMIT 10

label: pass
rationale: Correct join, per-currency sums, 3-month filter, top 10.
